verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for deployment automation and audit logs, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy, and probes for API docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. Having an API is adjacent to this story; it is not evidence of versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
